default_variant.heading: Default variant
default_variant.description: Choose the variant that should be used as the default for this product (e.g. for your storefront).

variant_thickness.heading: Thickness
variant_thickness.description: Set this variant's material thickness in millimeters (stored as metadata.thickness).
variant_thickness.label: Thickness (mm)
variant_thickness.invalid: Please enter a valid, non-negative number.

password_reset.subject: Reset your password – your verification code
password_reset.text:
Hello,

We have received a request to reset your password for your account ({email}).

Please click on the following link to set a new password:
{reset_url}

If you did not want to reset your password, you can ignore this email.

Best regards
{from_name}

order_confirmation.subject: Order confirmation – Order {reference}

bank_settings.bank_info: These bank details will be displayed on the order confirmation email.
bank_settings.info: Please transfer within 14 days of the order number.

theme_settings.title: Design
theme_settings.intro: Colours and images of your shop. Changes appear in the shop after saving.
theme_settings.surface_bg_hint: Cards, input fields and boxes – for example in the cart and at checkout
theme_settings.primary_hover_hint: Colour shown while the mouse is over a button
theme_settings.hero_bg_hint: The area behind the image on the home page
theme_settings.page_bg_hint: Base surface of all pages – also between the home image and the footer, and on product pages
theme_settings.page_text_hint: Base colour of all text. Choose a light colour on a dark background
theme_settings.logo_hint: Shown in the header and footer. Without a logo the shop name appears as text. PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best.
theme_settings.hero_hint: The large image on the home page. Without your own image the default one is used.
theme_settings.hover_bg_hint: Background of rows and input fields while the mouse is over them
theme_settings.upload_no_url: Upload did not return an address

customer_gpe.heading: GPE customer
customer_gpe.description: Links this shop customer to an existing GPE customer. First enter the GPE customer ID and check it to confirm the right customer, then save. The ID controls the customer discount and, later, order transmission to GPE.
customer_gpe.label: GPE customer ID
customer_gpe.check_not_found: No GPE customer found for this ID (or GPE unreachable).
customer_gpe.save_failed: GPE customer ID could not be saved.

auth_cleanup.title: Release e-mail / login
auth_cleanup.intro: Deletes the login identity (emailpass) of an e-mail address so it can be registered again. Only use this if the matching customer no longer exists.
auth_cleanup.success: Released: {customers} customer(s) and {identities} login identity/identities deleted.

email_settings.title: E-mail settings
email_settings.intro: These values are used for password reset e-mails (sender and link).

email_texts.title: E-mail texts
email_texts.intro: Subject and content of the automatic e-mails. Empty fields use the supplied text, shown as a preview inside the field.
email_texts.placeholders_hint: Write them exactly like this, including the braces. They are replaced when sending.

bundled_products.error_item_product: Every bundle item needs a selected product.
